shipped_rows.title_o: Past-focused environmental comparisons promote proenvironmental outcomes for conservatives

blind_target.authors: Clarke EJ, Ling M, Kothe EJ, Klas A, Richardson B.
blind_target.title: Mitigation system threat partially mediates the effects of right-wing ideologies on climate change beliefs.
blind_target.evidence_quote: When pitted against each other, we replicate recent findings that of these dimensions, SDO-E and Traditionalism demonstrate strongest unique associations with environmentalism [62].
blind_target.outcome_quote: When pitted against each other, we replicate recent findings that of these dimensions, SDO-E and Traditionalism demonstrate strongest unique associations with environmentalism [62].
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly state replication of this original paper’s finding about the strongest unique ideological associations. This is an additional retested finding in the exploratory analyses.

luna_triage.reason: Clarke et al. is cited as prior work on ideological associations, but the paper's explicit replication aims and analyses concern Baldwin and Lammers' temporal-framing interaction. The exploratory SDO analyses extend the ideology measure and do not retest a specific Clarke et al. finding. The supplied Baldwin and Lammers row is a different original and does not change that conclusion.
luna_triage.location: Introduction; Current studies; Study One; Results and discussion
luna_triage.omission_quote: These analyses are repeated with the dimensions of SDO in place of political orientation, to see whether we could replicate and extend upon Baldwin and Lammer's findings with a more nuanced measure of political orientation.
luna_triage.identity_quote: Clarke et al. [62] similarly showed that those who favoured traditionalism were more likely to deny climate change in many forms, through greater rejection of the science, existence, impacts, and anthropogenic nature of climate change.
luna_triage.duplicate_quote: We aim to replicate and extend Baldwin and Lammers' [9] third study

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
